newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 12.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Expected success of the centre-right ruling coalition in the upcoming parliamentary election may drive socialists to define their platform more precisely this week.
-- One hundred and three judges publish a manifesto calling for more independence for French judiciary.
-- LVMH chairman Bernard Arnault voted against merger of Guinness, in which LVMH holds a 14.2 percent stake, with GrandMet, and expressed reservations about its rationale.
-- Axa shareholders meet this afternoon to approve merger with UAP.
-- Gaz de France utility wins contract to build and manage gas distribution networks in five Argentine provinces.
-- Air France Europe to maintain 90 percent of domestic flights today despite pilots' strike which may last until court decision in dispute over pilots' status ahead of merger with Air France.
